remarks: Positioned at the end of a long drive along a quiet residential street, just moments from the very best of Highland Park's York Boulevard, this 3-bedroom TIC offers the ideal marriage of private retreat and urban living. Constructed in 2023 as part of an intimate 4-unit community, with only one shared wall (a double wall with soundproof insulation), the unit offers thoughtfully designed finishes and modern practicality, allowing it to live like a single-family home. Exterior shutters and lanterns evoke the charm of character-rich homes, while soaring vaulted ceilings amplify the spaciousness of the open-concept main living areas, anchored by wide-plank flooring that adds warmth to the space
